notes.title: WHAT'S COMING
notes.content:
[h3]First, a music preview:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=LTP_o8Ng5WM;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey everyone!

I figured a proof of life devlog was in order. [b]Simulacrum development has resumed [/b]after a brief (ish) hiatus!  

Technically it’s been resumed for a while, but I haven’t had much to show as [b]the next update revamps most of the game.[/b]

It’s been a lot of slow, frustrating technical work as some old, horrible code is thrown out and revamped, some is tolerated until it breaks, and some I have to stop tolerating because it breaks. Game development is a joy!

The release of Factorio: Space Age also took a major toll on Toasterware productivity.

However, despite this variety of internal and external challenges, development presses onward!

And, fortunately, we’re at a point where I can make some definitive statements about the next update, although a lot of stuff is still up in the air. (This is intended to be a pun, for when one plays Simulacrum, you find yourself up in the air for the vast majority of your playtime).

[b]Here’s some of the stuff you’ll get in the next update:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313072/10ca382ab3f26347b18622e5eae5c6b312cbea13.png[/img]
[h3]Pretty animated skyboxes[/h3]
The void now twirls around you as you dance through the skies.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42313072/d143a7c5b084aa10ddfd759c7bc5956859e03ad6.png[/img]
[h3]Grapple overhaul[/h3]
Grappling is now faster, snappier, and allows for much more choice and expression in your movement. 

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42313072/d379c2974c6a0b6e97ea606a87bf6b8edef7d0cb.png[/img]
[h3]Weapon energy[/h3]
Weapons now use energy to fire, so you’ll need to think more about what weapons to use and when [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nx8YiTqKjQY]instead of spamming the grenade launcher for absolutely everything. (Great video though SomeMugGaming!)[/url]

Excess energy obtained will allow the player to OVERCHARGE and deal enormous amounts of damage in a guns-blazing fury. 

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42313072/f8df6692dfa3d246765331d324c412a077a499f6.png[/img]
[h3]Rebalancing[/h3]
Everything in the game has been fiddled with and tweaked so it all flows nicely with the new changes.

[previewyoutube=_NNLVavZfAA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Soundtrack remaster[/h3]
While making a bunch of new tracks for the game, I went in and touched up the old ones as well. 

At the start of development I wasn’t excited to try to put together a soundtrack. Now I have a blast with it. Is it any good? Who knows. I just love putting a bunch of loud synths together.

[h3]and finally,[/h3]
[h2]Simulacrum will now be known as DREAMRENDER![/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42313072/85c59b237ed8d32475f145ae00e4453e0f5358c7.png[/img]

This name conveys the vibe of the game much better. There’s also multiple other games named Simulacrum that have released by at this point and I hate answering the question "which one?"

The full name change will hit with the rest of the new content, but it will be the same game through Steam, so [b]everyone who owns Simulacrum will be a proud owner of a copy of DREAMRENDER when the update is ready for release.
[/b]
[h2]More updates to come![/h2]
The most exciting new content is also the most unfinished, so sadly I can’t show much of it here. But I’m very, very excited to get it out into the world. Make sure you’re on[url=https://x.com/toasterware] our X[/url] and [url=https://discord.com/invite/gHvw8xAWz8]Discord[/url] so you don’t miss it.

[b]Questions, comments, stuff you want to make sure gets fixed? Leave a comment here or send a message on Discord![/b]

Thanks for all the support! See you again soon ;)

-Pixelsplitter

notes.title: Simulacrum Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Simulacrum Patch 1.1 
"Poyo Patch"

A 🧌 emoji has been placed next to some of the changes.

🧌-Weapon info screen
🧌-General info screen

These screens are accessed on the Act Select screen, and contain info about weapons and gameplay that  is difficult to communicate otherwise.

-A few names added to the credits
-Demon Man Deluxe button added to the main menu
-Slicers are now less likely to ram into you at ~0.9c and instantly kill you
-It is slightly easier to throw enemies out of bounds and kill them
🧌-Death sound is now affected by audio settings
-3-2 is a bit nicer


Simulacrum Patch 1,2
"Troublesome Patch"

🧌-Weapon info screen (correct button)
🧌-General info screen (correct button)

-Slicers are no longer so concerned with avoiding ramming into you at ~0.9c and instantly killing you that they lose the ability to attack effectively

🧌-Spawners are now much louder.
🧌-Spawn radius on 1-2 reduced so spawners are easy to spot and learn about

notes.title: DELVE INTO THE DREAM
notes.content:
Simuiacrum is now out on Steam!

- 3 Acts
- 15 Levels
- 5 layers of music for each level
- 7 enemies
- 5 achievements
- 3 weapons
- 1 leg (works as a weapon)
- 1 photo of my dog in there somewhere

ToasterWare will return to active development in 2024.
In the meantime, the game is in a complete and (as far as I know) very stable state. 

Thanks for playing!
